definition.fact: P0455: Evaporative Emission System Large Leak Detected
definition.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)
definition.scope: GM wording of the generic code; SAE J2012 original text not obtained

causes.fact: Large leak or purge blockage: unseated EVAP tube connection
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)
causes.quote: A large leak can occur from an unseated tube connection, a damaged tube, a stuck opened canister vent valve or a stuck closed purge valve.

causes.fact: Damaged EVAP tube/line
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)

causes.fact: Canister vent valve stuck open
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)

causes.fact: Purge valve stuck closed
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)

causes.fact: Fuel tank cap not closed properly (one of 7 connections to inspect)
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)
causes.quote: 7. Fuel tank cap is closed properly (at refuel compartment)

causes.fact: Fuel filler pipe main flap unit stuck open
causes.document: Honda/Acura service bulletin (i-HDS), MC-10219672
causes.scope: Specific Acura models in bulletin only
causes.quote: The fuel main flap unit may have stuck open, causing a DTC to set.

definition.fact: P0442: Evaporative Emission System Small Leak Detected
definition.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)

causes.fact: Purge valve stuck open
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)
causes.quote: The leak can occur from a stuck open purge valve or stuck open canister vent valve.

causes.fact: Canister vent valve stuck open
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)

causes.fact: EVAP system not sealed / purge lines not properly connected
causes.document: GM Service Bulletin 21-NA-124 (EVAP P0442/P0455 diagnostic tips)

definition.fact: P0456: EVAP system leak detected (very small leak)

causes.fact: Fuel cap not completely closed after fueling
causes.document: Mazda Service Bulletin 01-013/18
causes.quote: The concern is most likely the result of the customer not getting the fuel cap completely closed after fueling the vehicle.

causes.fact: EVAP leak at vent control valve O-ring
causes.document: Nissan TSB: DTC P0456 caused by EVAP leak at vent control valve O-ring
causes.scope: Applied Nissan vehicles only; bulletin states not caused by loose cap for those vehicles

causes.fact: Some P0456 concerns corrected by PCM software update (Stellantis; SLVT required)
causes.document: Stellantis wiTECH SLVT P0456 communication

definition.scope: Mitsubishi OEM service info; GM uses 'Fuel Trim System Lean'

causes.fact: Split air cleaner outlet duct after MAF letting unmetered air in

causes.document: Ford PIP5549
causes.quote: Possible Cause Vacuum leak in intake or Purge.

causes.fact: Air box/filter fitment, MAF, A/F sensor faults; fuel injectors
causes.document: Mazda M-Tip (P0171 Fuel Trim too Lean)

causes.fact: Crankcase leak e.g. rear main seal / breather

causes.fact: OEM list: A/F sensor, MAF, injector, fuel pressure, intake air leak at gaskets, ECT/IAT/baro/MAP sensors, exhaust leak, purge solenoid, contaminated fuel, harness, ECM

causes.document: Ford TSB 25-2119
